#!/bin/bash
set -u
BASE=/home/storage/781/4477781/user/webapp
PIDFILE="$BASE/openwebui-runtime.pid"
LOCKFILE="$BASE/openwebui-runtime.lock"
GATEFILE="$BASE/.openwebui_proxy_gate"
EXPECTED="$BASE/envs/openwebui/bin/open-webui"

proc_state() {
    awk '{print $3}' "/proc/$1/stat" 2>/dev/null || true
}
identity_ok() {
    [ -r "/proc/$1/cmdline" ] || return 1
    cmd=$(tr '\000' ' ' < "/proc/$1/cmdline" 2>/dev/null || true)
    case "$cmd" in *"$EXPECTED"*" serve"*) return 0;; *) return 1;; esac
}
alive() {
    st=$(proc_state "$1")
    [ -n "$st" ] && [ "$st" != Z ]
}

exec 9>>"$LOCKFILE"
/usr/bin/flock -x 9
pid=$(cat "$PIDFILE" 2>/dev/null || true)
echo "OLD_PID=${pid:-MISSING}"
if [ -n "${pid:-}" ] && alive "$pid"; then
    identity_ok "$pid" || { echo 'IDENTITY=FAIL'; exit 30; }
    echo 'IDENTITY=PASS'
    kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
    for _ in $(seq 1 60); do
        alive "$pid" || break
        sleep .25
    done
    if alive "$pid"; then
        identity_ok "$pid" || { echo 'IDENTITY_CHANGED=FAIL'; exit 31; }
        echo 'TERM_TIMEOUT_ESCALATE=YES'
        kill -9 "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
        for _ in $(seq 1 20); do
            alive "$pid" || break
            sleep .25
        done
    fi
    alive "$pid" && { echo 'STOP=FAIL'; exit 32; }
    echo 'STOP=PASS'
else
    echo 'OLD_RUNTIME=ALREADY_DEAD'
fi

current=$(cat "$PIDFILE" 2>/dev/null || true)
[ "$current" = "$pid" ] && rm -f "$PIDFILE"

# Manual/operator restarts must not consume the automatic fault-recovery budget.
# Launch the canonical runtime directly while holding the same lifecycle lock that
# Passenger uses, then release the lock and verify local health before probing the
# public Passenger path.
LOGFILE="$BASE/openwebui-runtime.log"
echo 'LAUNCH=BEGIN'
/usr/bin/setsid /bin/bash "$BASE/run-openwebui.sh" >>"$LOGFILE" 2>&1 </dev/null &
launch_pid=$!
printf '%s\n' "$launch_pid" > "$PIDFILE"
chmod 600 "$PIDFILE"
echo "LAUNCH_PID=$launch_pid"

/usr/bin/flock -u 9
exec 9>&-

local_ok=0
for _ in $(seq 1 120); do
    if curl -fsS --max-time 1 http://127.0.0.1:18080/health >/tmp/owui-local-health.$$ 2>/dev/null; then
        local_ok=1
        break
    fi
    sleep 1
done
printf 'LOCAL_HEALTH='; cat /tmp/owui-local-health.$$ 2>/dev/null || true; echo
rm -f /tmp/owui-local-health.$$
[ "$local_ok" -eq 1 ] || { echo 'LOCAL_HEALTH=FAIL'; exit 35; }

newpid=$(cat "$PIDFILE" 2>/dev/null || true)
echo "NEW_PID=${newpid:-MISSING}"
[ -n "${newpid:-}" ] && alive "$newpid" && identity_ok "$newpid" || exit 34

[ -s "$GATEFILE" ] || { echo 'GATE_FILE=MISSING'; exit 33; }
gate=$(cat "$GATEFILE")
code=$(curl -ksS --max-time 120 -o /tmp/owui-restart-health.$$ -w '%{http_code}' -H "Cookie: __Host-owui_gate=$gate" https://www.powerpc-darwin.org/health || true)
echo "PASSENGER_HEALTH_HTTP=$code"
cat /tmp/owui-restart-health.$$ 2>/dev/null || true; echo
rm -f /tmp/owui-restart-health.$$
[ "$code" = 200 ] || { echo 'PASSENGER_HEALTH=FAIL'; exit 36; }

echo 'RESTART=PASS'
